title: Daniel: Messiah Cut Off — Day 5 — Resolution

panels.heading: TODAY’S PASSAGE
panels.content:
**Daniel 7, 9**

This devotional is being drafted. The full reading + reflection ships in a future writing pass.

In the meantime, open your Bible to Daniel 7, 9 and read it slowly. Sit with one phrase that catches you. Bring it back to mind tomorrow.

panels.heading: WHY THIS PASSAGE
panels.content:
Today’s pivot: Daniel: Messiah Cut Off. The whole canon points forward — and this reading carries its own thread of that long pointing.

Christ-link: Christ the cut-off Anointed (Dan 9:26).

panels.heading: A PRAYER
panels.content: Father, when I read this passage, let me see You truly. Slow my hurry. Soften my certainty. Show me what I have missed. Through Christ, who is the substance of every shadow. Amen.
